steps: 1. Frontend calls POST /files/request-upload with file details
2. Backend validates request and returns presigned S3 URL + upload token
3. Frontend uploads file directly to S3 using presigned URL
4. Frontend calls POST /files/confirm-upload with upload token and S3 key
5. Backend verifies S3 upload, creates FileMetadata record, returns CDN URL
6. Frontend can now use the CDN URL to display/access the file
security_features: Rate limiting: 5 uploads per minute per user
File type validation (images and documents only)

notes: JSON uses camelCase naming.
Pagination is 1-based.
Search endpoints use pageNumber/pageSize; lookup endpoints use pageIndex/pageSize.
All monetary values are decimal type.
Standard response wrapper has status, message, data, errors unless otherwise noted.
Some endpoints are [AllowAnonymous] during development.
Enhanced Response DTOs (v1.4.0):
- RoomTenantMappingResponseDto now includes joined fields: tenantName, tenantMobile, tenantEmail, roomNo, propertyId, propertyName
- TenantRentSettingResponseDto now includes joined fields: tenantName, tenantMobile, roomNo, roomId, tenantId, propertyId, propertyName
- All RoomTenantMapping endpoints (GetById, GetByRoom, GetByTenant, GetByOwner, Search) return enhanced DTOs
- All TenantRentSetting endpoints (GetById, GetByMapping, Search) return enhanced DTOs
- Performance optimization: Single database query with JOINs eliminates N+1 query problem
- Frontend benefits: Reduces API calls from 4-5 to 1 per entity, improving page load times
- Database optimization: Uses INNER JOIN queries on Tenant, Room, and Property tables
- Search functionality enhanced: Can now search by tenant name/mobile and property name
- Sorting options expanded: Can now sort by joined fields like TenantName, PropertyName
- Currency display: Frontend should still use lookup endpoints to get currency symbols/names (not embedded in responses)
Tenant Search Endpoint Updates (v1.3.1):
- Removed deprecated parameters: roomNumber, minRent, maxRent, boardingDateFrom, boardingDateTo, leavingDateFrom, leavingDateTo
- Added roomId parameter to filter tenants by specific room (replaces roomNumber)
- Added propertyId filter to find all unique tenants who rent rooms in a property
- Enhanced role-based access control: Tenant role can now access search endpoint but only sees their own record
- Role-based filtering behavior: Admin (all tenants), Owner (own tenants only), Tenant (self only - all filters ignored)
- Security: Tenant role search automatically forces tenantId=userId to prevent unauthorized access
- Endpoint now requires AdminOrOwnerOrTenantPolicy authorization (previously AdminOrOwnerPolicy)
Many-to-Many Relationship Implementation (Added v1.3):
- RoomTenantMapping: Junction table enabling one room to have multiple tenants and one tenant to occupy multiple rooms
- TenantRentSetting: Rent configuration per room-tenant mapping (replaces tenant-level rent fields)
- Room and Tenant entities are now independent - tenants are not directly assigned to rooms
- Create RoomTenantMapping to assign tenant to room, then create TenantRentSetting for rent details
- All endpoints include proper authorization checks - user must have access to both room AND tenant
- Soft delete pattern used (IsActive flag) - no hard deletes on mappings or settings
Validation System (Updated v1.2): All FluentValidation errors now return consistent response format:
- Custom ValidationFilter intercepts model validation failures
- All validation errors return unified format with responseCode: 400
- Message: 'Validation failed for the provided data'
- Errors array contains all validation messages in flat string array
- No longer uses default ASP.NET Core ValidationProblemDetails format
- Early termination prevents unnecessary processing on invalid requests
- Maintains existing FluentValidation rules and custom validation messages
File Upload System: File management system using AWS S3 and CloudFront CDN:
- Files are managed through centralized FileMetadata table
- Supported entities: tenant, owner, property, room
- File categories: PropertyImage, TenantImage, RoomImage, OwnerImage, TenantDocument
- Three-step upload process: request presigned URL → upload to S3 → confirm upload
- Rate limiting: 5 uploads per minute per user
- File size limit: 10MB (configurable)
- Supported file types: Images (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp) and Documents (.pdf, .doc, .docx, .txt)
- JWT authentication required for all file operations
- Role-based access control: Admin sees all files, Owners see their own entities only
- Background cleanup service removes orphaned files hourly
- Files served via CloudFront CDN for optimal global performance
RentTrack API endpoints enhanced (v1.1): All RentTrack endpoints now return additional fields (propertyName, tenantName, roomNo) populated via optimized database JOINs with NOLOCK hints.
SearchRentTracks: Enhanced search functionality now includes property names, tenant names, and room numbers in search terms, with expanded sorting options.
Performance optimization: Database queries use NOLOCK hints for improved read performance.
- Update frontend to integrate with new file upload workflow
Entity-specific file usage examples:
- Tenant: ProfilePicture (photos), Document (Aadhar/PAN)
- Owner: ProfilePicture (photos), Document (Aadhar/PAN)
- Property: PropertyImage (exterior/interior), Document (agreements)
- Room: RoomImage (room photos), Document (inspection reports)
